resources.string: Record trips on foot or by transport and compare distance and time in your history.
Your first saved trip will appear here.
No trips yet. Start one from Home.
No trips saved on this date.
Your trips on foot or by transport.
Routes are saved on this phone. This version does not create accounts or share your trips with other people.

Recording continues when you switch apps or lock the screen, with a notification. Location is used only when you start or resume a trip. Pausing stops GPS updates; saving or discarding ends the session. Uninstalling the app deletes its data.
Sign in with an email code, sync your data, and connect with another person through an accepted invitation.
The map is not available in this installation. You may still be able to record your trip using GPS.
Google Maps needs Google Play services on this device.
Record on foot or by transport. Time includes stops; do not pause in traffic when comparing times. You can lock the screen. Force stopping or restarting loses the unsaved session.
Searching for GPS… Wait for an accurate location before moving.
To draw your route, allow precise location while using the app.
Turn on device location to start.
Location could not be accessed. Check permissions and try again.
Google Play location services are not available.
There are not enough GPS points to save a route yet. Continue outdoors and move a few more meters.
What would you like to do with your trip?
Save or discard this trip, or return to Home keeping its current state. A recording trip continues in the background; a paused trip stays paused.
Could not save. Your trip is still here: please try again.
Could not load your trips. Please try again.
This route could not be found.
This route will be deleted from your phone. This cannot be undone.
Weak GPS signal: waiting for a more accurate location.
Choose the app language. Your choice will be saved on this phone.
Current language: %1$s. Tap to change it.
Tap to return to your trip and save it.
Background recording could not start. Open the trip, check location permission, and try again.
Notifications are disabled. You can return to your trip from Home.
No recent valid location: distance may be missing.
Route split by pauses or signal loss. Distance between segments is not counted; the total may be incomplete.
